newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian one-month T-bill yields maintain rise.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian one-month T-bill yields maintain rise.

text.p: Yields of one-month Lithuanian Treasury bills continued to rise at Monday's auction and the issue was oversubscribed, the central bank said.
The average yield was 9.79 percent, up from 9.33 percent at the last auction for one-month paper on November 4.
The highest yield was 10.41 percent and the lowest was 9.27 percent.
All of the 50 million litas issue was sold as banks placed more than 56 million litas worth of bids.
The settlement date is November 14 and the issue matures on December 13.
